description: This is a PHP class source file defining the 'Map' controller for the OpenCart admin dashboard extension, particularly for the 'Map' feature within the dashboard extension. It includes methods for rendering the map page, saving settings, and fetching map data via AJAX calls, handling configuration, permissions, and view rendering.

classes.name: Map
classes.description: Controller class for managing the dashboard map extension in OpenCart admin, providing methods for displaying the map settings, saving configuration, retrieving map data, and rendering related views.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main map configuration page, loads language strings, sets up breadcrumb navigation, and passes data to the view for display.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the map extension settings via AJAX, including permission checks and returning JSON response with success or error messages.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Returns the view for the dashboard map info, including user token.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Fetches data about orders grouped by country to be used for map visualization; outputs JSON data.
